8	# outputs:

80	def validate_schema(report: dict) -> list[str]:
81	    """Validate the entire public report schema instead of duplicating its field rules."""
82	    try:
83	        schema = json.loads(COMPLETENESS_SCHEMA.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
84	        validator = Draft7SubsetValidator(schema)
85	    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, SchemaDefinitionError) as exc:
86	        return [f"schema の読取/構築に失敗: {exc}"]
87	    violations = []
88	    for error in sorted(
89	        validator.iter_errors(report),
90	        key=lambda item: tuple(str(part) for part in item.absolute_path),
91	    ):
92	        location = "/".join(str(part) for part in error.absolute_path) or "(root)"
93	        violations.append(f"schema {location}: {error.message}")
94	    return violations

97	def aggregate_verdict(aspect_verdicts: dict, high_count: int) -> str:
98	    """全観点と high finding から総合 verdict を fail-closed で再導出する。"""
99	    if set(aspect_verdicts) != set(ASPECTS):
100	        return "FAIL"
101	    if any(value not in ASPECT_VERDICTS for value in aspect_verdicts.values()):
102	        return "FAIL"
103	    if high_count > 0:
104	        return "FAIL"
105	    return "PASS" if all(value == "PASS" for value in aspect_verdicts.values()) else "FAIL"
106	
107	
108	def _high_count(findings: list) -> int:
109	    return sum(1 for finding in findings if isinstance(finding, dict) and finding.get("severity") == "high")
